summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built GPU-accelerated, computationally-constrained control systems: replaced TorchScript CNN layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels for a 1.5-2x inference speedup via memory coalescing, and derived full system dynamics (DH-parameter kinematics) for real-time trajectory control on a 6-DoF UR5e over ROS2. Deployed real-time embedded safety and control layers (interrupt-driven UART, FreeRTOS task coordination, user override) on Jetson, Arduino, and STM32 platforms, and validated an autonomous driving control stack in CARLA with zero collisions under dense dynamic traffic.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — 1.5-2x speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) into a real-time adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 with dense traffic and pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct signal compliance across multiple regression laps.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM actuation control with interrupt-driven UART command handling and a manual safety override on an STM32 target.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for real-time shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED telemetry display.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
